text:
deploybot: Preflight eval finished for release v2.14.0 -> gating checks show a quality delta outside tolerance for /summarize. Delta: +2.9% (worse) ROUGE-L vs baseline. Automatic promotion halted and staged fallback engaged. Report: https://ci.redwood/summaries/2075 (artifacts + failing prompts)

ana: Not great. That delta is above our 2.0% soft threshold. Anyone see this locally or is it infra/noise?

mike: I reproduced locally on the quantized candidate (model id: candidate-2026-03-19-q8). Long-document prompts show higher omission/hallucination rate.

liz: QA: failing suite entries -> summarizer/weekly_legal_long (4 failures). Example failure snippet:
```
Input: <long legal doc>
Expected: key points list
Got: high-level fluff + invented clause
```
Also added the failing prompts to /evals/failing/2075001234.json

tom: Customer-facing traffic currently remains on stable for 90% of requests; new candidate at 10% (staged fallback). Any immediate user-facing errors reported? Status page clear.

ana: OK, decision needed: full rollback of the release or keep staged fallback and bisect? Product is pushing for minimal disruption to rollout schedule.

hannah: From product POV, prefer a staged fallback (pin canary to stable) and buy time to triage — we can update release notes and announce a delayed model change if needed.

mike: Proposal: 1) keep staged fallback (10% candidate pinned to prior behavior), 2) start automated bisect across quantization/compile combos, 3) if bisect resolves within 4 hours -> resume promotion; else escalate to full rollback.

liz: +1. I'll run the focused regression harness: `eval-suite run --suite summarizer_long --save-diffs` and surface example pairs for reviewers.

deploybot: Bisect job kicked: bisect-342 started (targets: q8 vs q4, compiled kernels A/B). ETA ~45m. Logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/342

tom: I'll prep the rollback playbook (steps, routes, customer comms). If bisect fails, call me with `rollback-ready` and I'll enact a full revert to model:gpt-slim-rc1 across prod.

mike: Early hypothesis is quantization + attention-split optimization introduced subtle token dropping on long contexts. If fix is trivial kernel tweak we can patchfast; if not, plan hotfix release for next window.

ana: Action list: mike = bisect + triage, liz = regression diffs + failing prompts, tom = rollback ready, hannah = draft release note language and customer messaging, ana = update release doc and notify PM execs. We keep the release window locked until triage completes.

liz: Adding failing prompts and annotations now. I'll also tag the eval-suite PR with `release-blocker`.

deploybot: Fallback routing confirmed: 90% -> stable, 10% -> candidate. Promotion paused. Will post bisect updates to this thread.

ana: Thanks team. Keep updates concise here and add any critical logs to the job link. If bisect finds a single bad build, we prefer a hotfix branch over full rollback.

mike: Acknowledged — starting bisect run now.

hannah: I'll hold public release notes until we decide final path, but drafting internal comms now.

tom: Standing by.

(threads will update with deploybot job statuses)
